name: Hasumi Ai
source: Has had a crush on Hiyama since they were classmates in their first year, and followed him to the student council as the secretary. She’s friendly to anyone, regardless of who they are, and is always willing to break the ice no matter what situation she’s in. Even at times when she loses confidence in herself, she’s able to put in the work to express how she thinks. Despite technically being her rival in love, she sees Sakurai as her highly respectable senior.
